name: Sovereign debt stress
summary: France–Bund spread near 160bp, above the 150bp Alert line, as unions strike on 5 Nov
state: France's 10-year spread over German Bunds was reported near 160bp in the week to 5 Nov, above the 150bp Alert line, as the 2027 budget vote slipped toward a 17 Nov deadline (Journal du Coin; Trading Economics). Unions held a nationwide strike on 5 Nov (Al Jazeera). No failed G7 auction or emergency ECB buying has been reported.
for_you: Higher French borrowing costs can feed through to euro-area mortgage and corporate rates; this describes market conditions only.

sources.title: Journal du Coin — Vie chère, spread à 160 points, mobilisation du 5 novembre
Trading Economics — France 10Y government bond yield
Al Jazeera — Workers strike across France

why: When big governments struggle to borrow, it raises everyone's costs and can force sudden austerity or money-printing.
drivers: Deficits, auction demand, ratings actions, political shocks, long-end yields.

rubric.alert: Failed G7 auction, emergency central-bank purchases, France–Bund > 150bp, or Italy–Bund > 250bp.
rubric.watch: G7 30-year yields at multi-decade highs, a G7 downgrade, or France–Bund 80–150bp / Italy–Bund 150–250bp.
rubric.normal: Auctions orderly; France–Bund spread < 80bp; Italy–Bund < 150bp; no G7 downgrades this month.
